title: Grok Build hooks configuration
description: Schema for grok-build hook definition files: ~/.grok/hooks/*.json, <git-root>/.grok/hooks/*.json, ~/.grok/hooks/imported-from-claude.json, .cursor/hooks.json, and the "hooks" key embedded in Claude-compatible settings.json/settings.local.json files. Parsing entry point: parse_hook_file -> HooksMap::from_value [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:208-237]. A file is a JSON object with a top-level "hooks" key; other top-level keys (e.g. permissions/mcpServers/model in a Claude settings.json) are ignored by the hooks loader and therefore unconstrained here [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:223-226]. Under "hooks", each key names an event and maps to an array of matcher groups. Event-name keys are matched leniently: unrecognized keys are skipped with a warning rather than rejected, so a document may contain hook-event-shaped keys this schema does not recognize [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:28-36]. Default per-handler timeout is 5s; handlers registered under a Stop-gate event (Stop, SubagentStop) default to 600s because gate hooks run real verification (builds/tests) and fail open on timeout [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:89-105].

hookEventName.description: All spellings accepted by HookEventName's hand-written Deserialize impl: the 15 canonical PascalCase event names, plus snake_case and camelCase forms, plus per-operation aliases (e.g. beforeShellExecution/beforeMCPExecution/beforeReadFile all map to PreToolUse; beforeSubmitPrompt maps to UserPromptSubmit, which has no separate camelCase spelling of its own) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/event.rs:37-91].

matcherGroupArray.description: Value of one event key under "hooks": an ordered list of matcher groups; source order within an event is preserved [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:255-256].

matcherGroup.description: One matcher group: a regex pattern plus the handlers that fire for it [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:57-62].

matcher.description: Regex tested against the event's match value (e.g. tool name). Absent, null, or an empty string matches every event in this group; for events whose MatcherPolicy is Ignored (Stop, UserPromptSubmit), a configured matcher is kept for display but never compiled, so the hook always fires and a load-time warning is emitted [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:59-60,257-273].

hooks.description: Handlers to run when this group's matcher fires [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:61].

handler.description: A single hook handler (RawHandler) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:64-76]. Deserialization itself accepts any string for "type", but the loader rejects any value other than "command"/"http" at load time with HookError::UnsupportedHandlerType, and separately requires "command" (for command handlers) or "url" (for http handlers) to be present [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:305-347].

type.description: Handler kind; only "command" and "http" are accepted by the loader (HandlerType) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:65-67,109-114,305-316].

command.description: Executable/script path for a command handler, resolved relative to the hooks file's directory; required when type is "command" [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:68,322-334].

url.description: HTTP endpoint for an http handler; required when type is "http" [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:69,336-347].

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (converted to milliseconds internally). Defaults to 5s, or 600s for handlers registered under a Stop-gate event (Stop, SubagentStop) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:70-71,89-105].

env.description: Extra environment variables for the hook process, as a string-to-string map. Explicit null is tolerated and treated as an empty map via a hand-written deserializer (deserialize_optional_string_map); non-string values fail to parse [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:72-87]. Runner-reserved keys (GROK_HOOK_EVENT, GROK_HOOK_NAME, GROK_SESSION_ID, GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) are stripped at load time with a warning [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:378-393].

hooksObject.description: The parsed "hooks" value (HooksMap::from_value): keys are event names, values are matcher-group arrays. A recognized event-name spelling (see $defs.hookEventName) must have a matcher-group-array-shaped value, since a malformed value under a recognized key is a hard parse error (HookError::ParseFile) for the whole file [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:21-54]. Unrecognized keys (typos, or third-party event names such as PermissionRequest/TaskCreated/FileChanged/WorktreeCreate) are skipped with a warning and their value is never inspected, so they are intentionally left unconstrained here rather than rejected [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/config.rs:28-36].
